The charly toolchain layer (the on-PATH `charly` CLI plus its VM /
encrypted-storage / console-relay stack), declared at project scope so
the `charly` candy that `layer-agentteams-snapshot` composes resolves
in this project's candy closure. The snapshot bed needs an in-venue
`charly` for `charly agentteams snapshot|apply`; the production
agentteams box deliberately does not carry it, so it is provided as a
project-closure dependency, not composed into any image.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `check` | the charly CLI is present on PATH |
